name: Steak, Chips & Peppercorn Sauce
method: Cut the potatoes into chunky chips, toss with oil and bake at 220°C for 35–40 minutes, turning once.
Season the steaks and fry in a very hot pan for 3 minutes each side; rest them.
In the same pan, stir the crème fraîche with crushed black pepper and a splash of water. Serve with the peas.
